cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'm filling the shared car log. What were the mileage, fuel level and driver after nine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I mean all three blanks. Start with mileage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Driver I remember. The rest means going down six flights to the glovebox.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the book and bring you tea on the way back. Then you can give me the whole row in order.

mechanism: A controls the order and completeness of a seemingly neutral account, declining B shortcuts that would expose which missing answer A most wants.
confusable: Open interrogation is confusable: A must preserve broad completion as the reason for asking, not repeatedly spotlight the decisive answer.
comparison: Party report uses controlled dictation and photo prompts; shared car log uses a physical retrieval task to retain whole-row sequencing.
seedUse: All four canonical seeds read. D174-single-a is a protected unresolved source, used critically rather than inherited approval. Preserve only the party-report context; exact card governs concealment. D174-b supplies the car-log sequence and costly helpful offer.
